dn29:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati, vedhaññā nāma sakyā, tesaṃ ambavane pāsāde.
dn29:1.3: nigaṇṭhanātaputtakālakiriyā tena kho pana samayena nigaṇṭho nātaputto pāvāyaṃ adhunā kālakato hoti.
dn29:1.4: tassa kālakiriyāya bhinnā nigaṇṭhā dvedhikajātā bhaṇḍanajātā kalahajātā vivādāpannā aññamaññaṃ mukhasattīhi vitudantā viharanti
dn29:1.5: “na tvaṃ imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ ājānāsi, ahaṃ imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ ājānāmi. kiṃ tvaṃ imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ ājānissasi! micchāpaṭipanno tvamasi, ahamasmi sammāpaṭipanno. sahitamme, asahitante. pure vacanīyaṃ pacchā avaca, pacchā vacanīyaṃ pure avaca. aviciṇṇante viparāvattaṃ, āropito te vādo, niggahito tvamasi cara vādappamokkhāya, nibbeṭhehi vā sace pahosī”ti.
dn29:1.6: vadho yeva kho maññe nigaṇṭhesu nātaputtiyesu anuvattati ye
dn29:1.7: pi nigaṇṭhassa nātaputtassa sāvakā gihī odātavasanā, te tesu nigaṇṭhesu nātaputtiyesu nibbinnarūpā virattarūpā paṭivānarūpā, yathā taṃ durakkhāte dhammavinaye duppavedite aniyyānike anupasamasaṃvattanike asammāsambuddhappavedite bhinnathūpe appaṭisaraṇe.
dn29:2.1: atha kho cundo samaṇuddeso pāvāyaṃ vassaṃ vuttho, yena sāmagāmo yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho cundo samaṇuddeso āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca:
dn29:2.2: nigaṇṭho bhante nātaputto pāvāyaṃ adhunā kālakato.
dn29:2.3: tassa kālakiriyāya bhinnā nigaṇṭhā dvedhikajātā …pe… bhinnathūpe appaṭisaraṇe’ti.
dn29:2.4: evaṃ vutte āyasmā ānando cundaṃ samaṇuddesaṃ etadavoca:
dn29:2.5: atthi kho idaṃ āvuso cunda, kathāpābhataṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
dn29:2.6: āyāmāvuso cunda, yena bhagavā tenupasaṃkamissāma. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocessāmā’ti.
dn29:2.7: ‘evaṃ bhante’ti kho cundo samaṇuddeso āyasmato ānandassa paccassosi.
dn29:3.1: atha kho āyasmā ca ānando cundo ca samaṇuddeso yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn29:3.2: ayaṃ bhante cundo samaṇuddeso evamāha: “nigaṇṭho bhante nātaputto pāvāyaṃ adhunā kālakato.
dn29:3.3: tassa kālakiriyāya bhinnā nigaṇṭhā dvedhikajātā …pe… bhinnathūpe appaṭisaraṇe”ti. asammā sambuddhappavedita - dhammavinayo
dn29:4.1: “evaṃ hetaṃ cunda asammāsambuddhappavedite dhammavinaye hoti durakkhāte dhammavinaye duppavedite aniyyānike anupasamasaṃvattanike asammāsambuddhappavedite.
dn29:4.2: idha cunda satthā ca hoti asammāsambuddho, dhammo ca durakkhāto duppavedito aniyyāniko anupasamasaṃvattaniko asmmāsambuddhappavedito,
dn29:4.3: sāvako ca tasmiṃ dhamme na dhammānudhammappaṭipanno viharati na sāmīcipaṭipanno na anudhammacārī, vokkamma ca tamhā dhammā vattati.
dn29:4.5: “tassa te āvuso lābhā, tassa te suladdhaṃ,
dn29:4.6: satthā ca te asammāsambuddho dhammo ca durakkhāto duppavedito aniyyāniko anupasamasaṃvattaniko asammāsambuddhappavedito,
dn29:4.7: tvañca tasmiṃ dhamme na dhammānudhammapaṭipanno viharasi na sāmīcipaṭipanno na anudhammacārī, vokkamma ca tamhā dhammā vattasī”ti.
dn29:4.8: iti kho cunda satthā pi tattha gārayho, dhammopi tattha gārayho, sāvako ca tattha evaṃ pāsaṃso.
dn29:4.9: yo kho cunda evarūpaṃ sāvakaṃ evaṃ vadeyya
dn29:4.10: “etāyasmā tathā paṭipajjatu yathā te satthārā dhammo desito paññatto”ti,
dn29:4.11: yo ca taṃ samādapeti yañca samādapeti yo ca samādapito tathattāya paṭipajjati, sabbe te bahuṃ apuññaṃ pasavanti.
dn29:4.13: evaṃ hetaṃ cunda hoti durakkhāte dhammavinaye duppavedite aniyyānike anupasamasaṃvattanike asammāsambuddhappavedite.
dn29:5.1: idha pana cunda satthā ca hoti asammāsambuddho, dhammo ca durakkhāto duppavedito aniyyāniko anupasamasaṃvattaniko asammāsambuddhappavedito,
dn29:5.2: sāvako ca tasmiṃ dhamme dhammānudhammappaṭipanno viharati sāmīcipaṭipanno anudhammacārī, samādāya taṃ dhammaṃ vattati.
dn29:5.4: “tassa te āvuso alābhā, tassa te dulladdhaṃ, satthā ca te asammāsambuddho, dhammo ca durakkhāto duppavedito aniyyāniko anupasamasaṃvattaniko asammāsambuddhappavedito.
dn29:5.5: tvañca tasmiṃ dhamme dhammānudhammappaṭipanno viharasi sāmīcipaṭipanno anudhammacārī, samādāya taṃ dhammaṃ vattasī”ti.
dn29:5.6: iti kho cunda satthāpi tattha gārayho, dhammopi tattha gārayho, sāvako pi tattha evaṃ gārayho.
dn29:5.7: yo kho cunda evarūpaṃ sāvakaṃ evaṃ vadeyya.
dn29:5.9: yo ca pasaṃsati yañca pasaṃsati yo ca pasaṃsito bhiyyosomattāya viriyaṃ ārabhati. sabbe te bahuṃ apuññaṃ pasavanti.
dn29:5.11: evaṃ hetaṃ cunda hoti durakkhāte dhammavinaye duppavedite aniyyānike anupasamasaṃvattanike asammāsambuddhappavedite. sammāsambuddhappavedita - dhammavinayo
dn29:6.1: idha pana cunda, satthā ca hoti sammāsambuddho, dhammo ca svākkhāto suppavedito niyyāniko upasamasaṃvattaniko sammāsambuddhappavedito,

dn29:6.4: “tassa te āvuso alābhā, tassa te dulladdhaṃ, satthā ca te sammāsambuddho, dhammo ca svākkhāto suppavedito niyyāniko upasamasaṃvattaniko sammāsambuddhappavedito,
dn29:6.5: tvañca tasmiṃ dhamme na dhammānudhammapaṭipanno viharasi na sāmīcipaṭipanno na anudhammacārī, vokkamma ca tamhā dhammā vattasī”ti.

dn29:6.8: “etāyasmā tathā paṭipajjatu yathā te satthārā dhammo desito paññatto”ti.
dn29:6.9: yo ca samādapeti yaṃ ca samādapeti yo ca samādapito tathattāya paṭipajjati, sabbe te bahuṃ puññaṃ pasavanti.
dn29:6.11: evaṃ hetaṃ cunda hoti svākkhāte dhammavinaye suppavedite niyyānike upasamasaṃvattanike sammāsambuddhappavedite.
dn29:7.1: idha pana cunda, satthā ca hoti sammāsambuddho, dhammo ca svākkhāto suppavedito niyyāniko upasamasaṃvattaniko sammāsambuddhappavedito,
dn29:7.2: sāvako ca tasmiṃ dhamme dhammānudhammapaṭipanno viharati, sāmīcipaṭipanno anudhammacārī, samādāya taṃ dhammaṃ vattati,

dn29:7.5: satthā ca te sammāsambuddho dhammo ca svākkhāto suppavedito niyyāniko upasamasaṃvattaniko sammāsambuddhappavedito,
dn29:7.6: tvañca tasmiṃ dhamme dhammānudhammapaṭipanno viharasi, sāmīcipaṭipanno anudhammacārī, samādāya taṃ dhammaṃ vattasī”ti.

dn29:7.10: yo ca pasaṃsati yaṃ ca pasaṃsati, yo ca pasaṃsito bhiyyosomattāya viriyaṃ ārabhati, sabbe te bahuṃ puññaṃ pasavanti.
dn29:7.12: evaṃ hetaṃ cunda hoti svākkhāte dhammavinaye suppavedite niyyānike upasamasaṃvattanike sammāsambuddhappavedite. sāvakānutāpakarā satthukālakiriyā
dn29:8.1: idha pana cunda, satthā ca loke udapādi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, dhammo ca svākkhāto suppavedito niyyāniko upasamasaṃvattaniko sammāsambuddhappavedito,
dn29:8.2: aviññāpitatthā cassa honti sāvakā saddhamme na ca nesaṃ kevalaparipūraṃ brahmacariyaṃ āvikataṃ hoti uttānīkataṃ sabbasaṅgāhapadakataṃ sappāṭihīrakataṃ yāva devamanussehi suppakāsitaṃ,
dn29:8.4: evarūpo kho cunda, satthā sāvakānaṃ kālaṃ kato ānutappo hoti.
dn29:8.6: satthā ca no loke udapādi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, dhammo ca svākkhāto suppavedito niyyāniko upasamasaṃvattaniko sammāsambuddhappavedito, aviññāpitatthā camha saddhamme, na ca no kevalaparipūraṃ brahmacariyaṃ āvīkataṃ hoti uttānīkataṃ sabbasaṅgāhapadakataṃ sappāṭihīrakataṃ yāva devamanussehi suppakāsitaṃ,
dn29:8.8: evarūpo kho cunda, satthā sāvakānaṃ kālakato ānutappo hoti. sāvakānaṃ anānutappā satthukālakiriyā
dn29:9.1: idha pana cunda, satthā ca loke udapādi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho. dhammo ca svākkhāto suppavedito niyyāniko upasamasaṃvattaniko sammāsambuddhappavedito.
dn29:9.2: viññāpitatthā cassa honti sāvakā saddhamme, kevalañca tesaṃ paripūraṃ brahmacariyaṃ āvikataṃ hoti uttānīkataṃ sabbasaṅgāhapadakataṃ sappāṭihīrakataṃ yāva devamanussehi suppakāsitaṃ
dn29:9.4: evarūpo kho cunda satthā sāvakānaṃ kālakato anānutappo hoti.
dn29:9.6: satthā ca no loke udapādi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho.
dn29:9.7: dhammo ca svākkhāto suppavedito niyyāniko upasamasaṃvattaniko sammāsambuddhappavedito

dn29:9.10: evarūpo kho cunda, satthā sāvakānaṃ kālakato anānutappo hoti. brahmacariyaaparipūranādi kathā
dn29:10.1: etehi ce pi cunda, aṅgehi samannāgataṃ brahmacariyaṃ hoti, no ca kho satthā ca hoti thero rattaññū cirapabbajito addhagato vayo anuppatto,
dn29:10.2: evaṃ taṃ brahmacariyaṃ aparipūraṃ hoti tenaṅgena.
dn29:10.3: yato ca kho cunda, etehi ce pi aṅgehi samannāgataṃ brahmacariyaṃ hoti satthā ca hoti thero rattaññū cirapabbajito addhagato vayo anuppatto,
dn29:10.4: evaṃ taṃ brahmacariyaṃ paripūraṃ hoti tenaṅgena.
dn29:11.1: etehi ce pi cunda, aṅgehi samannāgataṃ brahmacariyaṃ hoti, satthā ca hoti thero rattaññū cirapabbajito addhagato vayo anuppatto, no ca khvassa therā bhikkhu sāvakā honti viyattā vinītā visāradā pattayogakkhemā,

dn29:12.10: majjhimā cassa bhikkhuniyo sāvikā honti vyattā …pe… no ca khvassa navā bhikkhuniyo sāvikā honti …pe…

dn29:16.1: yāvatā kho cunda, etarahi satthāro loke uppannā, nāhaṃ cunda aññaṃ ekasatthārampi samanupassāmi evaṃ lābhaggayasaggappattaṃ yatharivāhaṃ.
dn29:16.2: yāvatā kho pana cunda, etarahi saṅgho vā gaṇo vā loke uppanno,
dn29:16.3: nāhaṃ cunda aññaṃ ekasaṃghampi samanupassāmi evaṃ lābhaggayasaggappattaṃ yatharivāyaṃ cunda bhikkhusaṅgho.
dn29:16.4: yaṃ kho taṃ cunda, sammā vadamāno vadeyya
dn29:16.5: sabbākāraparipūraṃ anūnaṃ anadhikaṃ svākkhātaṃ kevalaparipūraṃ brahmacariyaṃ suppakāsitanti,
dn29:16.8: uddako sudaṃ cunda, rāmaputto evaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati:
dn29:16.11: khurassa sādhu nisitassa talamassa passati, dhārañca khvassa na passati.
dn29:16.14: yaṃ kho panetaṃ cunda, uddakena rāmaputtena bhāsitaṃ hīnaṃ gammaṃ pothujjanikaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ khurameva sandhāya,
dn29:16.16: ‘passaṃ na passatī’ti, idameva taṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya
dn29:16.19: evaṃ sabbākārasampannaṃ sabbākāraparipūraṃ anūnaṃ anadhikaṃ svākkhātaṃ kevalaparipūraṃ brahmacariyaṃ suppakāsitanti, iti hetaṃ passati
dn29:16.20: idamettha apakaḍḍheyya, evaṃ taṃ parisuddhataraṃ assāti, iti hetaṃ na passati.
dn29:16.21: idamettha upakaḍḍheyya, evaṃ taṃ parisuddhataraṃ assāti iti hetaṃ na passati.
dn29:16.24: yaṃ kho taṃ cunda, sammā vadamāno vadeyya
dn29:16.28: sabbākārasampannaṃ sabbākāraparipūraṃ anūnaṃ anadhikaṃ svākkhātaṃ kevalaparipūraṃ brahmacariyaṃ suppakāsitanti. saṅgāyitabbā dhammā
dn29:17.1: tasmātiha cunda, ye vo mayā dhammā abhiññā desitā, tattha sabbeheva saṅgamma samāgamma atthena atthaṃ byañjanena byañjanaṃ saṅgāyitabbaṃ na vivaditabbaṃ. yathayidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ addhaniyaṃ assa ciraṭṭhitikaṃ. tadassa bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.
dn29:17.2: katame ca vo cunda dhammā mayā abhiññā desitā yattha sabbeheva saṅgamma samāgamma atthena atthaṃ byañjanena byañjanaṃ saṅgāyitabbaṃ na vivaditabbaṃ, yathayidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ addhaniyaṃ assa ciraṭṭhitikaṃ, tadassa bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ
dn29:17.3: seyyathīdaṃ: cattāro satipaṭṭhānā, cattāro sammappadhānā, cattāro iddhipādā, pañcindriyāni, pañca balāni, satta bojjhaṅgā, ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo.
dn29:17.4: ime kho te cunda, dhammā mayā abhiññā desitā,
dn29:17.5: yattha sabbeheva saṅgamma samāgamma atthena atthaṃ byañjanena byañjanaṃ saṅgāyitabbaṃ, na vivaditabbaṃ, yathayidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ addhaniyaṃ assa ciraṭṭhitikaṃ, tadassa bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ. saññāpetabba vidhi
dn29:18.1: tesaṃ ca vo cunda, samaggānaṃ sammodamānānaṃ avivadamānānaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ aññataro sabrahmacārī saṃghe dhammaṃ bhāseyya.
dn29:18.3: “ayaṃ kho āyasmā atthañceva micchā gaṇhāti, byañjanāni ca micchā ropetī”ti.
dn29:18.4: tassa neva abhinanditabbaṃ, nappaṭikkositabbaṃ. anabhinanditvā appaṭikkositvā so evamassa vacanīyo
dn29:18.5: “imassa nu kho āvuso atthassa imāni vā byañjanāni etāni vā byañjanāni katamāni opāyikatarāni imesaṃ vā byañjanānaṃ ayaṃ vā attho eso vā attho, katamo opāyikataro?ti”
dn29:18.7: “imassa kho āvuso atthassa imāneva byañjanāni opāyikatarāni yāneva etāni ‘imesaṃ byañjanānaṃ, ayameva attho opāyikataro yāneva eso’ti,
dn29:18.8: so neva ussādetabbo na apasādetabbo. anussādetvā anapasādetvā sve va sādhukaṃ saññāpetabbo, tassa ca atthassa tesaṃ ca byañjanānaṃ nisantiyā.
dn29:19.1: aparopi ce cunda, sabrahmacārī saṅghe dhammaṃ bhāseyya,
dn29:19.3: “ayaṃ kho āyasmā atthaṃ hi kho micchā gaṇhāti, byañjanāni sammā ropetī”ti.
dn29:19.4: tassa neva abhinanditabbaṃ nappaṭikkositabbaṃ. anabhinanditvā appaṭikkositvā so evamassa vacanīyo
dn29:19.5: “imesaṃ nu kho āvuso byañjanānaṃ ayaṃ vā attho eso vā attho, katamo opāyikataro?”ti,
dn29:19.7: “imesaṃ kho āvuso byañjanānaṃ ayameva attho opāyikataro, yā ceva eso”ti.
dn29:19.8: so neva ussādetabbo na apasādetabbo. anussādetvā anapasādetvā sveva sādhukaṃ saññāpetabbo tasseva atthassa nisantiyā.
dn29:20.1: aparo pana cunda, sabrahmacārī saṅghe dhammaṃ bhāseyya,
dn29:20.3: “ayaṃ kho āyasmā atthaṃ hi kho sammā gaṇhāti, byañjanāni micchā ropetī”ti.
dn29:20.4: tassa neva abhinanditabbaṃ nappaṭikkositabbaṃ. anabhinanditvā appaṭikkositvā, so evamassa vacanīyo
dn29:20.5: “imassa nu kho āvuso atthassa imāneva byañjanāni etāni vā byañjanāni, katamāni opāyikatarānī?”ti.
dn29:20.7: “imassa nu kho āvuso atthassa imāneva byañjanāni opāyikatarā va yāni ceva etānīti,
dn29:20.8: so neva ussādetabbo na apasādetabbo. anussādetvā anapasādetvā sveva sādhukaṃ saññāpetabbo tesaññeva byañjanānaṃ nisantiyā.
dn29:21.1: aparopi ce cunda, sabrahmacārī saṅghe dhammaṃ bhāseyya,
dn29:21.3: “ayaṃ kho āyasmā atthañceva sammā gaṇhāti, byañjanāni ca sammā ropetī”ti,
dn29:21.5: tassa ‘sādhū’ti bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā so evamassa vacanīyo
dn29:21.7: ye mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ tādisaṃ brahmacāriṃ passāma evaṃ atthupetaṃ byañjanupetanti.” paccayānuññātakāraṇaṃ
dn29:22.1: na vo ahaṃ cunda, diṭṭhadhammikānaṃ yeva āsavānaṃ saṃvarāya dhammaṃ desemi.
dn29:22.2: na panāhaṃ cunda, samparāyikānaṃ yeva āsavānaṃ paṭighātāya dhammaṃ desemi.
dn29:22.3: diṭṭhadhammikānaṃ cevāhaṃ cunda, āsavānaṃ saṃvarāya dhammaṃ desemi.
dn29:22.5: tasmā tiha cunda yaṃ vo mayā cīvaraṃ anuññātaṃ, alaṃ vo taṃ
dn29:22.6: yāvadeva sītassa paṭighātāya, uṇhassa paṭighātāya, ḍaṃsamakasavātātapasiriṃsapasamphassānaṃ paṭighātāya, yāvadeva hirikopīnapaṭicchādanatthaṃ.
dn29:22.7: yo vo mayā piṇḍapāto anuññāto, alaṃ veso
dn29:22.8: yāvadeva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃsūparatiyā brahmacariyānuggahāya. iti purāṇañca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāmi navañca vedanaṃ na uppādessāmi, yātrā ca me bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro cāti.
dn29:22.9: yaṃ vo mayā senāsanaṃ anuññātaṃ, alaṃ vo taṃ
dn29:22.10: yāvadeva sītassa paṭighātāya uṇhassa paṭighātāya ḍaṃsamakasavātātapasiriṃsapasamphassānaṃ paṭighātāya yāvadeva utuparissayavinodanaṃ paṭisallānārāmatthaṃ.
dn29:22.11: yo vo mayā gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāro anuññāto, alaṃ vo so
dn29:22.12: yāvadeva uppannānaṃ veyyābādhikānaṃ vedanānaṃ paṭighātāya abyāpajjhaparamatāyā ti.
dn29:23.1: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ cunda vijjati, yaṃ aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyyuṃ
dn29:23.3: evaṃ vādino cunda aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evamassu vacanīyā
dn29:23.6: cattāro’me cunda, sukhallikānuyogā hīnā gammā pothujjanikā anariyā anatthasaṃhitā na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattanti.
dn29:23.8: idha cunda, ekacco bālo pāṇe vadhitvā vadhitvā attānaṃ sukheti pīṇeti.
dn29:23.10: puna caparaṃ cunda, idhekacco adinnaṃ ādiyitvā ādisitvā attānaṃ sukheti pīṇeti.
dn29:23.12: puna caparaṃ cunda, idhekacco musā bhaṇitvā bhaṇitvā attānaṃ sukheti pīṇeti.
dn29:23.14: puna caparaṃ cunda, idhekacco pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappito samaṅgibhūto paricāreti.
dn29:23.16: ime kho cunda, cattāro sukhallikānuyogā hīnā gammā pothujjanikā anariyā anatthasaṃhitā na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattanti.
dn29:24.1: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ cunda vijjati, yaṃ aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyyuṃ
dn29:24.4: na te sammā vadamānā vadeyyuṃ abbhācikkheyyuṃ asatā abhūtena.
dn29:24.5: cattāro’me cunda, sukhallikānuyogā ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattanti.
dn29:24.7: idha cunda, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn29:24.9: puna caparaṃ cunda, bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn29:24.11: puna caparaṃ cunda, bhikkhu pītiyā ca virāgā …pe… taṃ tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn29:24.13: puna caparaṃ cunda, bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā …pe… catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn29:24.15: ime kho cunda, cattāro sukhallikānuyoge ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattanti.
dn29:24.16: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ cunda vijjati, yaṃ aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyyuṃ
dn29:24.17: “ime cattāro sukhallikānuyogā anuyuttā samaṇā sakyaputtiyā viharantī”ti.
dn29:24.19: sammā te vo vadamānā vadeyyuṃ, na te vo abbhācikkheyyuṃ asatā abhūtena.
dn29:25.1: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ cunda vijjati, yaṃ aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyyuṃ
dn29:25.2: ‘ime pana āvuso cattāro sukhallikānuyoge anuyuttānaṃ viharataṃ kati phalāni katānisaṃsā pāṭikaṅkhā?”ti.
dn29:25.3: evaṃvādino cunda aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evamassu vacanīyā
dn29:25.4: “ime kho āvuso cattāro sukhallikānuyoge anuyuttānaṃ viharataṃ cattāri phalāni cattāro ānisaṃsā pāṭikaṅkhā.
dn29:25.6: idhāvuso, bhikkhu tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano.
dn29:25.8: puna caparaṃ āvuso, bhikkhu tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmi hoti sakideva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhassantaṃ karoti.
dn29:25.10: puna caparaṃ āvuso, bhikkhu pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā’ti.
dn29:25.12: puna caparaṃ āvuso, bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
dn29:25.14: ime kho āvuso, cattāro sukhallikānuyoge anuyuttānaṃ viharataṃ imāni cattāri phalāni cattāro ānisaṃsā pāṭikaṅkhā”ti. khīṇāsavānaṃ abhabbaṭṭhānāni
dn29:26.1: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ cunda vijjati, yaṃ aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyyuṃ
dn29:26.3: evaṃ vādino cunda, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evamassu vacanīyā:
dn29:26.4: atthi kho āvuso, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sāvakānaṃ dhammā desitā paññattā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyā.
dn29:26.5: seyyathāpi āvuso, indakhīlo vā ayokhīlo vā gambhīranemo sunikhāto acalo asampavedhī,
dn29:26.6: evameva kho āvuso, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sāvakānaṃ dhammā desitā paññattā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyā.
dn29:26.7: yo so āvuso, bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaññojano sammadaññā vimutto abhabbo so nava ṭhānāni ajjhācarituṃ:
dn29:26.8: abhabbo āvuso khīṇāsavo bhikkhu saṃcicca pāṇaṃ jīvitā voropetuṃ. abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādiyituṃ, abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevituṃ, abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu sampajānamusā bhāsituṃ, abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu sannidhikārakaṃ kāme paribhuñjituṃ, seyyathāpi pubbe āgārikabhūto. abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu chandāgatiṃ gantuṃ, abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu dosāgatiṃ gantuṃ, abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu mohāgatiṃ gantuṃ, abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu bhayāgatiṃ gantuṃ.
dn29:26.9: yo so āvuso, bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaññojano sammadaññā vimutto, abhabbo so imāni nava ṭhānāni ajjhācaritu”nti. pañhabyākaraṇāni
dn29:27.1: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ cunda vijjati, yaṃ aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyyuṃ
dn29:27.2: “atītaṃ kho addhānaṃ ārabbha samaṇo gotamo atīrakaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paññapeti, no ca kho anāgataṃ addhānaṃ ārabbha atīrakaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paññapeti. tayidaṃ kiṃsu tayidaṃ kathaṃsū?”ti.
dn29:27.3: te ca aññatitthiyā paribbājakā aññavihitakena ñāṇadassanena aññavihitakaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paññāpetabbaṃ maññanti, yathariva bālā abyattā.
dn29:27.4: atītaṃ kho cunda, addhānaṃ ārabbha tathāgatassa satānusāri ñāṇaṃ hoti.
dn29:27.6: anāgatañca kho addhānaṃ ārabbha tathāgatassa bodhijaṃ ñāṇaṃ uppajjati
dn29:28.1: atītañcepi kho cunda hoti abhūtaṃ atacchaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, na taṃ tathāgato byākaroti.

dn29:28.4: anāgataṃ cepi cunda hoti abhūtaṃ atacchaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ …pe… paccuppannaṃ cepi
dn29:28.5: cunda hoti abhūtaṃ atacchaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ na taṃ tathāgato byākaroti.
dn29:28.6: paccuppannañcepi cunda hoti bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ tampi tathāgato na byākaroti.
dn29:28.7: paccuppannañcepi cunda hoti bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ atthasaṃhitaṃ, tatra kālaññū tathāgato hoti tassa pañhassa veyyākaraṇāya.

dn29:29.1: yañca kho cunda, sadevakassa lokassa samārakassa sabrahmakassa sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā, sabbaṃ tathāgatena abhisambuddhaṃ.
dn29:29.3: yañca cunda, rattiṃ tathāgato anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambujjhati, yañca rattiṃ anupādisesāya nibbānadhātuyā parinibbāti, yaṃ etasmiṃ antare bhāsati lapati niddisati, sabbaṃ taṃ tatheva hoti no aññathā.
dn29:29.5: yathāvādī cunda tathāgato tathākārī, yathākārī tathāvādī.
dn29:29.6: iti yathāvādī tathākārī, yathākārī tathāvādī, tasmā ‘tathāgato’ti vuccati.

dn29:30.1: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ cunda vijjati, yaṃ aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyyuṃ
dn29:30.2: “kinnu kho āvuso hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā? idameva saccaṃ, moghamaññanti?

dn29:31.1: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ cunda vijjati, yaṃ aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyyuṃ:
dn29:31.3: evaṃ vādino cunda aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evamassu vacanīyā:
dn29:31.4: “nahetaṃ āvuso atthasaṃhitaṃ na dhammasaṃhitaṃ na ādibrahmacariyakaṃ na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati. tasmā taṃ bhagavatā abyākatanti.” byākataṭṭhānāni
dn29:32.1: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ cunda vijjati, yaṃ aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyyuṃ
dn29:32.3: evaṃ vādino cunda, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evamassu vacanīyā:
dn29:32.4: “idaṃ dukkhanti kho āvuso bhagavatā byākataṃ. ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo’ti kho āvuso bhagavatā byākataṃ, ayaṃ dukkhanirodho’ti kho āvuso bhagavatā byākataṃ, ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti kho āvuso bhagavatā byākatanti”.
dn29:33.1: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ cunda vijjati, yaṃ aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyyuṃ
dn29:33.3: evaṃ vādino cunda, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evamassu vacanīyā:
dn29:33.4: “etañhi āvuso atthasaṃhitaṃ, etaṃ dhammasaṃhitaṃ, etaṃ ādibrahmacariyakaṃ, ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati. tasmā taṃ bhagavatā byākatanti.” pubbantasahagatā diṭṭhinissayā
dn29:34.1: ye pi te cunda, pubbantasahagatā diṭṭhinissayā, tepi vo mayā byākatā yathā te byākātabbā.
dn29:34.2: yathā ca te na byākātabbā kiṃ vo ahaṃ te tattha byākarissāmi?
dn29:34.3: ye pi te cunda aparantasahagatā diṭṭhinissayā, tepi vo mayā byākatā, yathā te byākātabbā.
dn29:34.4: yathā ca te na byākātabbā kiṃ vo ahaṃ te tattha byākarissāmi.
dn29:34.5: katame ca te cunda, pubbantasahagatā diṭṭhinissayā, ye vo mayā byākatā yathā te byākātabbā?
dn29:34.7: santi kho cunda, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino:
dn29:34.8: ‘sassato attā ca loko ca’ idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti.
dn29:34.9: santi pana cunda, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃ vādino evaṃ diṭṭhino:
dn29:34.11: sassato ca asassato ca attā ca loko ca,
dn29:34.12: neva sassato nāsassato attā ca loko ca,
dn29:34.15: sayaṃ kato ca para kato ca attā ca loko ca,
dn29:34.16: asayaṃkāro aparakāro adhiccasamuppanno attā ca loko ca, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti.
dn29:34.24: asayaṃkāraṃ aparaṃkāraṃ adhiccasamuppannaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ. idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti”.
dn29:35.1: tatra cunda, ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino
dn29:35.2: sassato attā ca loko ca, idameva saccaṃ, moghamaññanti.
dn29:35.10: aññathāsaññino pi hettha cunda santeke sattā.
dn29:35.11: imāya pi kho ahaṃ cunda, paññattiyā neva attanā samasamaṃ samanupassāmi kuto bhiyyo.
dn29:35.12: atha kho ahameva tattha bhiyyo yadidaṃ adhippaññatti.
dn29:36.1: tatra cunda, ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino “sassato attā ca loko ca,

dn29:36.8: asayaṃkāro aparakāro adhiccasamuppanno attā ca loko ca,

dn29:36.28: yathā ca te na byākātabbā, kiṃ vo ahaṃ te tattha byākarissāmī?”ti. aparantasahagatā diṭṭhinissayā
dn29:37.1: katame ca cunda, aparantasahagatā diṭṭhinissayā ye te mayā byākatā yathā te byākātabbā?
dn29:37.2: yathā ca te na byākātabbā kiṃ vo ahaṃ te tattha byākarissāmī?”ti.
dn29:37.3: santi cunda eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino:
dn29:37.4: “rūpī attā hoti arogo parammaraṇā, idameva saccaṃ, moghamaññanti.”
dn29:37.5: santi pana cunda eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino
dn29:37.7: rūpī ca arūpī ca attā hoti
dn29:37.12: attā ucchijjati vinassati, na hoti parammaraṇā, idameva saccaṃ, moghamaññanti.”
dn29:38.1: tatra cunda, ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino,
dn29:38.2: rūpī attā hoti arogo parammaraṇā, idameva saccaṃ, moghamaññanti.
dn29:38.10: aññathāsaññino pi hettha cunda santeke sattā.

dn29:39.11: “attā ucchijjati vinassati, na hoti parammaraṇā ti?”
dn29:39.17: imāyapi kho ahaṃ cunda, paññattiyā neva attanā samasamaṃ samanupassāmi kuto bhiyyo?

dn29:39.20: yathā ca te na byākātabbā, kiṃ vo ahaṃ te tattha byākarissāmī”ti imesaṃ
dn29:40.1: ca cunda, pubbantasahagatānaṃ diṭṭhinissayānaṃ imesaṃ ca aparantasahagatānaṃ diṭṭhinissayānaṃ pahānāya samatikkamāya evaṃ mayā cattāro satipaṭṭhānā desitā paññattā.
dn29:40.3: idha cunda, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ,
dn29:40.6: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
dn29:40.7: imesaṃ ca cunda, pubbantasahagatānaṃ diṭṭhinissayānaṃ imesaṃ ca aparantasahagatānaṃ diṭṭhinissayānaṃ pahānāya samatikkamāya. evaṃ mayā ime cattāro satipaṭṭhānā desitā paññattā ti.
dn29:41.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā upavāṇo bhagavato piṭṭhito hoti bhagavantaṃ vijayamāno.
dn29:41.2: atha kho āyasmā upavāṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn29:41.5: supāsādiko vatāyaṃ bhante dhammapariyāyo. ko nāmāyaṃ bhante dhammapariyāyo?”ti.
dn29:41.6: “tasmā tiha tvaṃ upavāṇa imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ pāsādikotveva naṃ dhārehī”ti.
dn29:41.8: attamano āyasmā upavāṇo bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti.
